deployments_detail.use: naviHealth "nH Predict" AI used in Medicare Advantage post-acute care claim decisions (litigation-documented); Optum AI broadly

Optum + Google Cloud collaboration to build AI-enabled real-time payer operations (eligibility, benefits, prior authorization/referrals, claims status) via digital workflows to cut call-center volume. [Google Cloud]

AI-assisted software development: roughly 20,000 UnitedHealth engineers use AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot / Microsoft Copilot / Azure AI) to write code, improve code quality and test coverage. [Microsoft GitHub Copilot / Azure AI]
deployments_detail.value: ~20,000 engineers using AI to write software

deployments_detail.use: nH Predict, a naviHealth algorithm used by UnitedHealthcare to predict how much post-acute/skilled-nursing rehab care a Medicare Advantage patient should need and to inform coverage/discharge decisions. [naviHealth (UnitedHealth subsidiary)]

Optum Real, an AI-backed real-time claims/benefits validation and digital prior-authorization platform that gives providers instant eligibility, benefit, claim and prior-auth answers embedded in clinical workflows, reducing calls and administrative burden. [Optum]
Ambient AI clinical documentation: AI transcribes and summarizes clinician-patient visit conversations to draft clinical notes, part of UnitedHealth's ~1,000 AI applications in production.
deployments_detail.value: ~1,000 AI applications in production (half generative AI)

deployments_detail.use: Optum AI Marketplace, a healthcare-specific platform to discover, test and buy AI apps/APIs (eligibility, claims, engagement, care management, analytics) from Optum and partners, launched to accelerate AI adoption among payers/providers. [Optum with Microsoft, Google, ServiceNow]

Avery, a generative-AI member companion in the UnitedHealthcare app and myuhc.com that answers coverage/claims/benefits questions in natural language 24/7, gives cost estimates, finds providers, and can schedule appointments on a member's behalf.
deployments_detail.value: Live to ~6.5M commercial + 160K Medicare Advantage members (expanding to 20.5M by year-end 2026); 90% of users who used Avery did not need an advocate

deployments_detail.use: AI-enabled provider (doctor) search for members that helps people find an in-network physician, a customer-facing production use case highlighted by the CTO.
deployments_detail.value: 18 million AI-enabled doctor searches in Q1 2025

deployments_detail.use: Optum contact-center intelligent virtual assistant (IVA) technology, including the One Assist omnichannel platform, that understands free-form spoken questions, routes callers and provides 24/7 self-service in multiple languages. [Optum]
AI in claims processing and fraud/waste detection: UnitedHealth uses AI to help adjudicate and process claims at scale as part of its production AI portfolio.
deployments_detail.value: handled 600+ million claims; averted 15+ million calls (per internal AI metrics)
